title: Eigenvectors stay on their own line
caption: A = [[4, 1], [2, 3]] sends (1, 1) to (5, 5) = 5(1, 1) and (1, −2) to (2, −4) = 2(1, −2): each eigenvector is only stretched, by its eigenvalue, and keeps its direction.
alt: The vector (1, 1) and its image (5, 5) along the same direction; the vector (1, −2) and its image (2, −4) along the same direction.
description: v = (1, 1) is mapped to Av = (5, 5), five times as long and pointing the same way (λ = 5).
w = (1, −2) is mapped to Aw = (2, −4), twice as long and pointing the same way (λ = 2).
Other vectors would be turned off their line; eigenvectors are the exceptions.
